recipes.name: CORNBREAD
instructions: For Classic Southern-Style Cornbread:
In a mixing bowl, whisk together cornmeal, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. - 2 cups coarsely ground cornmeal - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda

In a separate bowl, whisk eggs and buttermilk. Pour into the cornmeal mixture and stir with a spatula until combined, adding more cornmeal if needed for thickness. - 2 large eggs - 1 ½ cups buttermilk
In a cast iron skillet, melt lard over medium heat. Pour half of the melted lard into the batter and mix. - ½ cup lard

Heat the skillet with the remaining lard until very hot, then pour in the batter, smoothing the top. - 2 cups coarsely ground cornmeal - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 2 large eggs - 1 ½ cups buttermilk - ½ cup lard
Bake at 425°F for 20-25 minutes, until golden around the edges. Cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
For Delicate Southern-Style Cornbread:
In a mixing bowl, whisk together cornmeal, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. - 2 cups finely ground cornmeal - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs and buttermilk. Pour into the cornmeal mixture, creating a thin, cake-like batter. - 2 large eggs - 1 ½ cups buttermilk
Melt lard in a cast iron skillet, adding half to the batter. Heat the skillet with the remaining lard until hot. - ½ cup lard

Pour the batter into the skillet, smooth the top, and bake at 425°F for 20-25 minutes. - 2 cups finely ground cornmeal - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 2 large eggs - 1 ½ cups buttermilk - ½ cup lard
Test with a toothpick to ensure doneness. Cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
For Jalapeño Cheddar Cornbread:

In a bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cayenne pepper. Add cheese and toss to coat. - 5 oz finely ground cornmeal - 5 oz all purpose flour - ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp cayenne pepper - 4 oz grated cheddar cheese

In a food processor, pulse corn, buttermilk, honey, and jalapeño 6-8 times. Add eggs and melted butter; pulse until combined. - ½ cup fresh corn kernels - 1 ½ cups buttermilk - 2 tbsp honey or sweetener - 1 jalapeño pepper cored and sliced - 2 large eggs - 1 stick melted butter
Pour wet mixture into the dry ingredients and mix gently.
Grease the skillet with butter, add batter, and garnish with jalapeño slices. Bake at 425°F for 20-25 minutes.
Test with a toothpick, cool for 5-10 minutes, then brush with honey and sprinkle with sea salt. Cool for 10-15 minutes before serving. - Flaky sea salt (for garnish)
For Brown Butter Cornbread:

Combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar in a bowl. - 5 oz finely ground cornmeal - 5 oz all purpose flour - 8 tbsp unsalted butter - ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 1 tsp kosher salt - 3 tbsp sugar
Whisk eggs and buttermilk in a separate bowl. - 2 large eggs - 1 ½ cups buttermilk
In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat until browned, then cool with 2 ice cubes in a heat-proof container.
Mix the brown butter with the wet ingredients, then pour into the dry ingredients.
Pour batter into the same butter-coated skillet and bake at 425°F for 20-25 minutes.
Test with a toothpick, cool for 5-10 minutes, then brush with honey and sprinkle with sea salt. Cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
For Honey Butter:
Combine butter and honey in a mixer until light and fluffy. Serve with warm cornbread.
